blocks.text: Mayon Volcano erupts, Alert Level 3 raised — PHIVOLCS
The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS) on Friday reported a moderately explosive eruption of Mayon Volcano in Albay, prompting the raising of Alert Level 3.
In its Mayon Volcano Eruption Notification No. 1, PHIVOLCS said the eruption started at 11:53 a.m. and was still ongoing as of its latest advisory.
The eruption initially generated a grayish plume that rose approximately 3,000 meters above the crater and drifted west-southwest.
In a separate Facebook post, PHIVOLCS announced that Alert Level 3 has been raised over Mayon Volcano, which means increased tendency towards a hazardous eruption.
